verdict.rationale: Jan is documented as a desktop app with a built-in local OpenAI-compatible API server. That lets other applications call it, but the evidence never documents a headless mode, standalone CLI, or CI/automation usage; the server is only shown running inside the desktop app. The API server is an adjacent capability, not the headless/CI operation the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Jan provides a built-in, OpenAI-compatible API server that runs entirely on your computer, powered by `llama.cpp`.
